title: GTA 5 Cast Give Crucial Advice to GTA 6 Stars Jason and Lucia
description: IGN reports that the stars behind GTA 5 and San Andreas have shared essential advice for GTA 6 actors playing Jason and Lucia ahead of launch.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Preparing for Global Stardom in GTA 6

As the launch of *GTA 6* (GTA6) draws closer, the anticipation surrounding the game's protagonists, Jason and Lucia, continues to reach unprecedented heights. In a recent report by IGN Games, the legendary actors behind *GTA 5*—specifically the stars who brought Franklin, Michael, and Trevor to life—along with the voice actor of CJ from *San Andreas*, were asked what crucial advice they would offer to the actors stepping into the shoes of GTA 6's newest criminal duo.

## Wisdom from Rockstar Veterans

Stepping into a Rockstar Games protagonist role is a career-defining moment that instantly propels performers into global stardom. The actors from *GTA 5* and *San Andreas* know firsthand the unique experience of having a video game launch catapult them into immense fame, shifting fan culture, and intense public scrutiny. According to IGN, these industry veterans reflected on what Jason and Lucia's actors need to know most as they prepare for the monumental release of GTA 6.

## Editor's Take

The legacy of GTA characters goes far beyond standard voice acting; they become cultural icons. Hearing from the actors of GTA 5 and San Andreas highlights the unique journey awaiting the stars of GTA 6. As Jason and Lucia prepare to enter the gaming lexicon, the wisdom of their predecessors offers a fascinating glimpse into the human side of video game blockbusters.
